national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Inaugurates Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu became the first Indian President to hoist the official flag at the Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik.
The President released the official Kumbh song 'Har Har Gange' (composed by Ajay-Atul), launched the dedicated website, and unveiled a special postage stamp.
The event highlights long-term civic infrastructure projects in Nashik and Trimbakeshwar alongside national river cleaning initiatives.

national_news.title: Union Government Releases ₹1,09,019 Crore Advance Tax Devolution to States
bullets: Ministry of Finance released an additional tax devolution instalment of ₹1,09,019 crore to states on October 31, 2026, marking the second advance instalment of the financial year.
The release aims to enable state governments to accelerate capital spending and finance development and welfare-related expenditure.
Uttar Pradesh received the largest allocation of ₹19,208 crore, followed by Bihar at ₹10,845 crore and Madhya Pradesh at ₹8,010 crore.

national_news.title: Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Flagged Off; Northern Bullet Train Corridor Approved
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and UP CM Yogi Adityanath flagged off the fully air-conditioned 16-coach Vande Bharat Sleeper Express operating between Varanasi and New Delhi.
The Northern Corridor of the bullet train network was approved by PM Modi, planned to connect Delhi, Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Patna, and Guwahati.
Progress was reviewed on Namo Setu in Varanasi, a combined rail-road bridge featuring a six-lane highway on the upper deck and four railway tracks on the lower deck.

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates 31 Projects at Ekta Nagar Ahead of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for 31 tourism and infrastructure projects worth over ₹426 crore at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat.
Key inaugurated attractions include a 12-acre artificial Rain Forest featuring a circular glass skywalk, Vaman Vriksha Vatika, an IRCTC hotel, and the Ekta Cruise.
The visit was conducted as part of the 'Rashtriya Ekta Diwas' celebrations commemorating the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

national_news.title: SEBI Deploys 'Sudarshan' AI Tool and New Investor Safety Initiatives
bullets: SEBI announced the development of an artificial intelligence-based tool called 'Sudarshan' to detect social media violations and suspicious financial activities through a five-stage process.
SEBI partnered with Google to implement verified badges on Google Play Store for official financial apps and launched a multi-language WhatsApp investor channel.
Key initiatives highlighted include the SEBI Saarthi App, SEBI Check facility, the SCORES 2.0 grievance redressal portal, and the 'Samajh ke Investing Simple' campaign.

national_news.title: Centre Sets Up High-Level Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat 2047
bullets: The Ministry of Finance constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat, chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel, with a tenure of six months.
The committee includes RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Indian Bank MD & CEO Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan as members.

It will recommend structural, regulatory, and legislative reforms, suggest safeguards against cyber risks, and prepare a roadmap for AI and digital innovations across banks, including RRBs and Cooperative Banks.

national_news.title: EAM Advocates Diplomacy and Maritime Security at G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar addressed the first plenary session of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, USA, stressing diplomacy over military solutions to global conflicts.

EAM emphasized adherence to the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to protect freedom of navigation and civilian shipping, noting the disproportionate impact of supply chain disruptions on the Global South.
On the sidelines of the G20 meeting, India also engaged in the QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting alongside representatives from the US, Japan, and Australia.

national_news.title: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Navigation Satellite via GSLV-F18
bullets: ISRO successfully launched the 2,232 kg NVS-03 satellite into Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit using the GSLV-F18 rocket from Sriharikota, marking the 20th flight of the GSLV.
NVS-03 is the third satellite in the second-generation NavIC constellation, equipped with an indigenous atomic clock and introducing the L1 frequency band alongside existing L5 and S bands.
The mission strengthens India's independent positioning and timing system (NavIC), which provides coverage across India and up to 1,500 km beyond its borders.

national_news.title: EPFO Celebrates 74th Foundation Day with New Digital Initiatives
bullets: Union Minister for Labour & Employment Mansukh Mandaviya inaugurated the 74th Foundation Day of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) in New Delhi.
Key initiatives launched include Automatic Settlement of eligible inoperative EPF accounts with balances up to Rs 1,000 and EPFO service delivery via WhatsApp.
The Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 were presented to recognize outstanding contributions by regional and zonal offices of the EPFO.

bihar_news.title: TEA Global Experience Index: World's Top 10 Most Visited Museums Announced
bullets: The Themed Entertainment Association (TEA) released the TEA Global Experience Index report, registering 161.4 million visits to the world's top 20 museums in 2025—a 5.4% increase compared to 2024.
The Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing, China, emerged as the world's most visited museum with 19 million visitors in 2025, preserving around 1.8 million cultural objects.
Other major world museums in the top rankings included China's Summer Palace (17.38 million visitors) and France's Louvre Museum (9.05 million visitors).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Plans for State's Tallest Sardar Patel Statue in Patna
bullets: The Bihar state government announced plans to erect the state's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna during a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas programme at Bapu Sabhagar.
The initiative, organized by Sajhi Virasat Abhiyan on Patel's birth anniversary, commemorates his historic contribution in merging over 560 princely states into India.
The announcement was framed alongside national developmental goals toward building a 'Viksit Bharat' by 2047.

bihar_news.title: ISRO to Set Up Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium
bullets: ISRO experts inspected the site for a Space Gallery and Space Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium in Bihar to boost STEM education in the Mithila region.
The project covers two acres at an estimated cost of ₹61 crore, with technical support assured by Space Commission Chairman V. Narayanan.
The centre will showcase ISRO missions like Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Aditya-L1, and Gaganyaan through 3D/VR models and offer hands-on training in robotics and rocketry.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th Globally and 1st in Asia by German Travel Guide
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum secured the 9th rank in the list of the world's 100 best museums for 2026 released by German travel publication 'Worth a Journey'.
It became the highest-ranked museum in Asia, placed ahead of New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art (10th) and Paris's Musée du Louvre.
Mexico City's Museo Nacional de Antropología topped the global ranking of museums.

bihar_news.title: Architectural and Artifact Highlights of Bihar Museum
bullets: Bihar Museum was designed by Japan's Maki and Associates in collaboration with Mumbai-based Opolis, using weathering-steel, terracotta, and local stone.
The museum houses the iconic 5-foot 2-inch Didarganj Yakshi, a polished Chunar sandstone sculpture discovered in Patna in 1917.
Its chronological history galleries cover major regional empires including the Mauryas, Sungas, Kushanas, Guptas, and Palas.

bihar_news.title: BIRSAC Signs MoU with Survey of India for Geospatial Collaboration in Bihar
bullets: The Bihar Remote Sensing Application Centre (BIRSAC) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Survey of India (SOI) in Patna during the Space Application Adoption Workshop 2026.
The agreement enables technical collaboration in geospatial data sharing, capacity building, and joint projects to aid urban planning and disaster management in Bihar.
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary attended the event and launched the 'TechConnect' portal to integrate space-based technology into state governance.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Directs Education Department Officers to Integrate AI into Administrative Work
bullets: Bihar's Education Department issued an advisory to District Education Officers (DEOs) encouraging officials to adopt generative AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude for drafting letters and monitoring state schemes.
The state IT Department is procuring enterprise licences for ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot to distribute among departments.
Staff capacity building will be conducted using the Central Government's iGOT online learning portal, supported by a nodal AI framework set up across departments.

bihar_news.title: HPCL to Set Up ₹159-Crore Compressed Biogas Plant in Bhagalpur, Bihar
bullets: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) plans to construct a ₹159 crore Compressed Biogas (CBG) plant at Kankaithi in Bhagalpur, Bihar.
The plant will process 135 tonnes of segregated municipal wet waste per day to generate green fuel (CBG) and organic agricultural manure.
Bhagalpur Municipal Corporation will provide 10 acres of land free of cost for 25 years, after which the operational facility will be transferred to the civic body.
